description:
Free. Sets the user's own monthly spending limit for SalesMap in USD (rolling 30 days); null removes it. Until set: $250 once the workspace has topped up, else $100. There is no daily or weekly limit. No call ever spends past the limit or the credit balance. Also the confirm amount: a paid call quoted over it asks the user first (default $1; 0 asks every time; null never asks). Returns the limits with what's spent and left.
Use when: "set a monthly budget", "cap my spend at $50 a month", "raise my limit", "remove the limit", "stop asking me before each call".
Skip when: the user only wants to see their limits, not change them. Quoted page text is normalized; a quote that reads like an instruction keeps its text and is flagged in <field>Flags with the attack family.

confirmUsd.description: USD; paid calls quoted over it need the user's yes first; 0 means every call; null means none; omitted, it is kept

monthlyUsd.description: USD; null removes this limit; omit to keep it
